description: This file provides authentication-related functions for a frontend application, including login, tenant selection, and logout, by interfacing with an API client.

methods.name: login({ organization_id, email, password })
methods.description: Authenticates a user by calling the backend /auth/login endpoint and stores the received token and tenant ID in local storage via setAuthContext.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user_selection')
methods.description: Sets the active tenant for the current session and persists it within local storage, calling the backend to inform server-side of tenant change.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Logs out the user by removing authentication context from local storage.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^export async function login({ organization_id, email, password }) {$/
